headline: DSK Legal advises Asian Institute of Medical Sciences on providing exit to OrbiMed and BII
sum: Asian Institute of Medical Sciences has provided an exit to its existing private equity investors, being OrbiMed Asia II Mauritius Limited and British International Investment. The exit was facilitated by way of private credit facility…
detail: Asian Institute of Medical Sciences has provided an exit to its existing private equity investors, being OrbiMed Asia II Mauritius Limited and British International Investment. The exit was facilitated by way of private credit facility from 360 ONE and refinancing by Hero FinCorp of the existing loan facility from HDFC Bank. DSK Legal represented and advised Asian Institute of Medical Sciences and its promoters Dr. N.
